answer: To resist sybils, require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can transact, and let the stake shrink by a delta each time the agent is caught misbehaving. Honest behavior is verified by rotating independent peers whose verdicts echo across the network, so a fake identity cannot hide behind one friendly witness. New agents start inside a nebula of limited trust: they may only take small jobs until repeated attestations raise their standing. Forging a thousand identities means locking a thousand stakes and passing a thousand peer reviews, which costs far more than any fraud gains.
